    elif line.startswith("position"):

    elif line.startswith("go"):

            sys.stdout.write("bestmove 0000\n")
        else:

            sys.stdout.write(f"bestmove {move.uci()}\n")
        sys.stdout.flush()
    elif line == "quit":
        sys.exit(0)
    elif line == "stop":
        return

    # position [fen <fen> | startpos] moves <m1> <m2> ...

        rest = parts[1:]
    if "moves" in rest:
        j = rest.index("moves")
        for u in rest[j + 1 :]:
            b.push_uci(u)
    return b


def main() -> None:
    for line in sys.stdin:
        handle(line)


if __name__ == "__main__":
